description: A GUEST ASKS THE HOSTS FOR SOMETHING. Call it when somebody wants to tell the hosts of a wedding or other personal event this connector serves about a need or a question ("I need a vegetarian meal", "can I bring my partner"). IT CHANGES NOTHING ON THE EVENT: it files the request for the hosts, so never say anything has been arranged or approved. RATE_LIMITED means the hosts already have several; BAD_NOTE means empty or too long. It requires a personal connector token.

category.description: dietary, accessibility, plus_one, travel or other.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the hosts spell it.

note.description: What they asked, in their own words, up to 280 characters; no contact details or links.

name: event_send_request
title: Send the hosts a request about a personal event
